verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: The bound one is bound by habit-impression; मोक्ष is the destruction of habit-impression. Having abandoned habit-impression, abandon also the desire for मोक्ष.।

verses.sanskrit: मानसीर्वासनाः पूर्वं त्यक्त्वा विषयवासनाः । मैत्र्यादिवासनानाम्नीर्गृहाणामलवासनाः
verses.transliteration: mānasīrvāsanāḥ pūrvaṃ tyaktvā viṣayavāsanāḥ | maitryādivāsanānāmnīrgṛhāṇāmalavāsanāḥ
verses.translation: Having first given up the habit-impressions of the mind that concern the objects of sense, take up the pure ones called friendliness and the like.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Having first given up the habit-impressions of मन that concern the objects of sense, take up the pure ones called friendliness and the like.।

verses.sanskrit: ता अप्यतः परित्यज्य ताभिर्व्यवहरन्नपि । अन्तःशान्तः समस्नेहो भव चिन्मात्रवासनः
verses.transliteration: tā apyataḥ parityajya tābhirvyavaharannapi | antaḥśāntaḥ samasneho bhava cinmātravāsanaḥ
verses.translation: Having abandoned even these, though dealing with them, be inwardly at peace, equal in affection, with the impression of pure consciousness alone.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Having abandoned even these, though dealing with them, be inwardly at peace, equal in affection, with the impression of pure चैतन्य alone.।

verses.sanskrit: तामप्यथ परित्यज्य मनोबुद्धिसमन्विताम् । शेषस्थिरसमाधानो मयि त्वं भव मारुते
verses.transliteration: tāmapyatha parityajya manobuddhisamanvitām | śeṣasthirasamādhāno mayi tvaṃ bhava mārute
verses.translation: Then, having abandoned even that, which belongs to the mind and intellect, with the remainder steady and composed, be yourself in me, Maruti.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Then, having abandoned even that, which belongs to मन and intellect, with the remainder steady and composed, be yourself in me, Maruti.।

verses.sanskrit: अशब्दमस्पर्शमरूपमव्ययं तथाऽरसं नित्यमगन्धवच्च यत् । अनामगोत्रं मम रूपमीदृशं भजस्व नित्यं पवनात्मजार्तिहन्
verses.transliteration: aśabdamasparśamarūpamavyayaṃ tathā'rasaṃ nityamagandhavacca yat | anāmagotraṃ mama rūpamīdṛśaṃ bhajasva nityaṃ pavanātmajārtihan
verses.translation: Without sound, without touch, without form, imperishable, also without taste, eternal, and without smell, without name and lineage — such is my form; worship it always, son of the Wind, destroyer of sorrow.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Without sound, without touch, without form, imperishable, also without taste, eternal, and without smell, without name and lineage — such is my form; worship it always, son of the Wind, destroyer of sorrow.।

verses.sanskrit: दृशिस्वरूपं गगनोपमं परं सकृद्विभातं त्वजमेकमक्षरम् । अलेपकं सर्वगतं यदद्वयं तदेव चाहं सकलं विमुक्तॐ
verses.transliteration: dṛśisvarūpaṃ gaganopamaṃ paraṃ sakṛdvibhātaṃ tvajamekamakṣaram | alepakaṃ sarvagataṃ yadadvayaṃ tadeva cāhaṃ sakalaṃ vimuktaoṃ
verses.translation: Of the nature of the seer, like space, supreme, shining once, unborn, one, imperishable, unsullied, all-pervading, without a second — that I am, entirely free.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Of the nature of the seer, like space, supreme, shining once, unborn, one, imperishable, unsullied, all-pervading, without a second — that I am, entirely free.।

verses.sanskrit: दृशिस्तु शुद्धोऽहमविक्रियात्मको न मेऽस्ति कश्चिद्विषयः स्वभावतः । पुरस्तिरश्चोर्ध्वमधश्च सर्वतः सुपूर्णभूमाहमितीह भावय
verses.transliteration: dṛśistu śuddho'hamavikriyātmako na me'sti kaścidviṣayaḥ svabhāvataḥ | purastiraścordhvamadhaśca sarvataḥ supūrṇabhūmāhamitīha bhāvaya
verses.translation: I am the pure seer, of unchanging nature; by nature I have no object whatever. In front, across, above, below, everywhere — contemplate here: "I am the fully complete fullness."
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am the pure seer, of unchanging nature; by nature I have no object whatever. In front, across, above, below, everywhere — contemplate here: "I am the fully complete fullness.।

verses.sanskrit: अजोऽमरश्चैव तथाजरोऽमृतः स्वयंप्रभः सर्वगतोऽहमव्ययः । न कारणं कार्यमतीत्य निर्मलः सदैव तृप्तोऽहमितीह भावय
verses.transliteration: ajo'maraścaiva tathājaro'mṛtaḥ svayaṃprabhaḥ sarvagato'hamavyayaḥ | na kāraṇaṃ kāryamatītya nirmalaḥ sadaiva tṛpto'hamitīha bhāvaya
verses.translation: Unborn, deathless, ageless, immortal, self-luminous, all-pervading, imperishable — I am; beyond cause and effect, stainless, ever satisfied — contemplate here: "I am that."
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Unborn, deathless, ageless, immortal, self-luminous, all-pervading, imperishable — I am; beyond cause and effect, stainless, ever satisfied — contemplate here: "I am that.।

verses.sanskrit: जीवन्मुक्तपदं त्यक्त्वा स्वदेहे कालसात्कृते । विशत्यदेहमुक्तत्वं पवनोऽस्पन्दतामिव
verses.transliteration: jīvanmuktapadaṃ tyaktvā svadehe kālasātkṛte | viśatyadehamuktatvaṃ pavano'spandatāmiva
verses.translation: Having abandoned the state of liberation while living, when the body has been given to time, one enters bodiless liberation, as the wind enters stillness.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Having abandoned the state of मोक्ष while living, when शरीर has been given to time, one enters bodiless मोक्ष, as the wind enters stillness.।

verses.sanskrit: तदेतदृचाभ्युक्तम्
verses.transliteration: tadetadṛcābhyuktam
verses.translation: Of this a verse says:
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Of this a verse says:।

verses.sanskrit: तद्विष्णोः परमं पदं सदा पश्यन्ति सूरयः । दिवीव चक्षुराततम्
verses.transliteration: tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padaṃ sadā paśyanti sūrayaḥ | divīva cakṣurātatam
verses.translation: The wise always see that supreme abode of Vishnu, like an eye spread out in the sky.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: The wise always see that supreme abode of Vishnu, like an eye spread out in the sky.।

verses.sanskrit: तद्विप्रासो विपन्यवो जागृवांसः समिन्धते । विष्णोर्यत्परमं पदम्
verses.transliteration: tadviprāso vipanyavo jāgṛvāṃsaḥ samindhate | viṣṇoryatparamaṃ padam
verses.translation: The wise, the vigilant, the inspired, kindle that supreme abode of Vishnu.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: The wise, the vigilant, the inspired, kindle that supreme abode of Vishnu.।

verses.sanskrit: ॐ सत्यमित्युपनिषत् । ॐ पूर्णमदः पूर्णमिदं पूर्णात्पूर्णमुदच्यते । पूर्णस्य पूर्णमादाय पूर्णमेवावशिष्यते
verses.transliteration: oṃ satyamityupaniṣat | oṃ pūrṇamadaḥ pūrṇamidaṃ pūrṇātpūrṇamudacyate | pūrṇasya pūrṇamādāya pūrṇamevāvaśiṣyate
verses.translation: Om. Truth — thus the Upanishad. Om. That is full; this is full; from the full the full arises. Taking the full from the full, the full alone remains.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Om. Truth — thus the Upanishad. Om. That is full; this is full; from the full the full arises. Taking the full from the full, the full alone remains.।
